snippet.title: DeadCore Redux Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Check out the Steam page for more details here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484260
5 Bits Games is excited to announce DeadCore Redux, a remastered version of our 2014 title DeadCore.

DeadCore Redux is a challenging game that will test your platforming skills and your precision.
The remaster features enhanced graphics and audio, gamepad support, a brand new story level and a new offline ranking for even more challenge.

DeadCore Redux will be released towards the end of Q2 on Steam.

Feel free to wishlist the game to support us and stay updated on all future developments!
Follow us for news on updates and upcoming demo!
